items.markdown:
Thailand long-term visa costs vary by program, ranging from `1,900 THB for basic annual extensions up to millions of Baht for premium packages` . The main long-term options include the 10-year Long-Term Resident (LTR) visa at 50,000 THB, the 10-year Non-O-X visa at 10,000 THB, and the Thailand Privilege (Elite) visa starting at 650,000 THB.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) [[1]](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/)[[2]](https://thaielite-express.com/how-to-stay-in-thailand-long-term-5-visa-options-explained-2026-guide/)[[3]](https://consular.mfa.go.th/th/content/80939-non-%E2%80%93-immigrant-visa-%E2%80%9Co-x%E2%80%9D-%28long-stay-10-years%29?menu=5d68c88b15e39c160c0081e6&page=5d68c88b15e39c160c0081e5)[[4]](https://www.henleyglobal.com/residence-investment/thailand)

Major Long-Term Visa Programs and Costs

- **Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa:** Costs **50,000 THB** (approx. $1,500 USD) for a 10-year multiple-entry visa aimed at wealthy individuals, pensioners, remote workers, and skilled professionals.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 
- **Non-Immigrant O-X Visa:** Costs **10,000 THB** for a 10-year stay (5-year validity plus a 5-year extension) specifically for retirees aged 50 and older from select countries.[](https://consular.mfa.go.th/th/content/80939-non-%E2%80%93-immigrant-visa-%E2%80%9Co-x%E2%80%9D-%28long-stay-10-years%29?menu=5d68c88b15e39c160c0081e6&page=5d68c88b15e39c160c0081e5) 
- **Thailand Privilege (Elite) Visa:** Ranges from **650,000 THB** to over **5,000,000 THB** depending on membership tier, granting stays from 5 to 20 years with VIP perks.[](https://www.henleyglobal.com/residence-investment/thailand) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/retirement-visa)
- **Standard Retirement (Non-O / Non-O-A) Visa:** Costs roughly **2,000 THB** for the initial 90-day/1-year entry, plus **1,900 THB** for yearly extensions at local immigration offices.[](https://thaielite-express.com/how-to-stay-in-thailand-long-term-5-visa-options-explained-2026-guide/) 
- **Destination Thailand Visa (DTV):** Offers a lower-cost 5-year validity for digital nomads and remote workers, with standard multiple-entry embassy application fees.[](https://thaielite-express.com/how-to-stay-in-thailand-long-term-5-visa-options-explained-2026-guide/) [[1]](https://itsbetterinthailand.com/destination-thailand-visa-dtv-digital-nomad-visa/)[[2]](https://www.austchamthailand.com/resources/news/thailand-digital-nomad-visas-comparing-best-options-remote-workers)[[3]](https://www.ptservicesagency.com/en/visa/thailand/dtv)

Applications can typically be processed online through the official [Thailand e-Visa System](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) or specialized boards like the [Thailand Board of Investment LTR Portal](https://ltr.boi.go.th/).[[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/long-term-resident-visa)If you'd like to narrow this down, please tell me:

- Your **age** 
- Your **reason for staying** (retirement, remote work, investing, or general long stay)
- Your **approximate budget** 

I can help you find the best visa match.
